title: The Paradise of the Devil
synopsis: A Cuban colonel, disillusioned with the state of his country’s military, confronts Castro, kills him, and takes command of the island. He expects the Cuban people to support his takeover. Instead, a civilian army rises against his troops. As the struggle for control intensifies, a secret left over from the Cuban Missile Crisis draws the United States into a confrontation with consequences far beyond Cuba.
sourceSynopsis: The Paradise of the Devil; A Cuban Colonel fed up with the condition of the military, confronts Castro. The Colonel kills Castro, takes command of Cuba, thinking the civilians of Cuba would support his takeover of the Cuban Island. The Colonel underestimated the Cuban people and a civilian army is organized and attack the Colonel's troops. Discover the secret Castro sat on since the Cuban missile crisis and what that secret causes the United States to respond.
tagline: A coup in Cuba. A buried secret. A nation on the brink.

title: The Vulture Will Lead You to Death
synopsis: Terrorists enter the United States from Cuba with a plan to strike the Port of Miami. They know a supertanker is docked at the seaport and intend to turn it into a devastating target. What they do not know is that a massive ship carrying military supplies is stationed nearby. Its presence could magnify the destruction, turning an already deadly attack into a far greater catastrophe.
sourceSynopsis: The Vulture Will Lead You to Death; See how terrorists enter the United States from Cuba, their target Miami Seaport/ The terrorists are armed with the knowledge of a super oil tanker docked at that Seaport, but are unaware an equally massive armament ship carry military supplies is stationed at the Seaport and will add to the destructive force once they attack.

The Vulture Will Lead You To Death

tagline: At the Port of Miami, one attack could change everything.

title: The Vector
synopsis: In this geopolitical thriller, Iran responds to war with a covert biological attack on the United States. Eight volunteers are fitted with false teeth containing a deadly agent and sent through Mexico toward eight American cities. Their orders are to release the agent and spread the infection before it kills them. The novel follows the threat of an attack carried by people rather than conventional weapons.
sourceSynopsis: After the attack on Israel on October 7th, and with the United States joining the war. Iran decides to strike the United States. Iran gets eight volunteers, removes a tooth from each of the volunteers and replaces them with hollowed out teeth with a deadly biological agent stored in the false tooth. Then these Vectors, a Vector is someone infected with a disease and these Vectors are ordered to go to Mexico, enter the United States through the El-Passo Pass with orders to head for eight major cities. There they are to destroy the false tooth, giving the Vectors three to five days to infect ten X ten x ten people before the Vector's succumb to the deadly germ.
tagline: Eight operatives. Eight cities. A threat without borders.

title: The Warning of Ramses
synopsis: Egypt’s dependence on the Nile becomes the fault line of an international conflict. When Ethiopia builds a dam on the Blue Nile and sharply reduces the water reaching Egypt, the dispute moves toward war. Joined by Libyan forces, Egypt confronts Ethiopia and the United States over the project. A struggle over a river becomes a crisis with consequences across the region.
sourceSynopsis: The Warning of Ramses. Egypt's constant fear is another country constructing a dam on the Blue Nile feeder River and cutting off the flow of the Nile River to Egypt. Read how Ethiopia does build a dam on the Blue Nile and cuts off 90% of the Blue Nile to Egypt, forcing Egypt, being joined by Libyan forces goes to war with Ethiopia and the United States over this project.
tagline: When the Nile stops flowing, the world moves toward war.

title: IFF: Identify Friend or Foe
synopsis: An Iranian pilot steals an F-18 and turns it against an American aircraft carrier in the Persian Gulf. In the novel’s central premise, the aircraft’s friendly identification signal becomes a dangerous vulnerability: the systems designed to prevent friendly fire also obstruct the fleet’s response to an enemy flying one of its own aircraft. A safeguard intended to save lives becomes the opening for a devastating attack.
sourceSynopsis: IFF: Identify Friend or Foe; throughout history many inventions were developed to save lives. The IFF system makes it impossible for an American aircraft to fire on another American aircraft. In this case, if one American pilot armed a missile and aimed it at another American aircraft, immediately the missile firing system will pick up the other aircraft's IFF signal and force that aimed missile to go into a sleep mode, making it impossible to be fired at another friendly aircraft. See what happens when an Iranian pilot steals an F-18 and fly's that aircraft at the American Carrier stationed in the Persian Gulf,. Read how the IFF signal emitted from the Carrier and her support ships, makes it impossible to stop the stolen aircraft from attacking and sinking the carrier.
tagline: The system built to protect them becomes their greatest vulnerability.

title: God’s Sword of Justice
synopsis: Terrorists seize the control room of the Indian Point nuclear power plant in New York and shut off cooling water to the reactor. The novel places the facility within a nine-hour window before a catastrophic meltdown, with the surrounding region facing long-term contamination. Walker’s elite soldiers must stop the attackers before their plan turns a nuclear facility into a weapon.
sourceSynopsis: God’s Sword of Justice Terrorists found a way to get into the control room of the Indian Point Nuclear Power plant in New York. When they invaded the control room, they closed the C-2 valve and stopped the cooling water for the reactor. Placing the reactor in a nine-hour window before it started the China Syndrome before the reactor entered the meltdown process, placing a hundred-mile radius in danger of becoming contaminated by radiation for a hundred years. Walker's elite soldiers are needed to stop the terrorists from accomplishing what they plan.
tagline: A nuclear reactor. A narrowing window. An impossible mission.

title: Operation Glass Slipper
synopsis: A doctor discovers a microbe that survives by consuming carbon in crude oil. Working with a microbiologist, he alters it so it can travel through the air and consume the carbon polluting the atmosphere. The discovery promises an extraordinary environmental benefit. But a small group of terrorists sees a different possibility and seeks to exploit the research in the development of a biological weapon.
sourceSynopsis: Glass Slipper's about a Doctor discovers a Microbe in the crude oil surviving devouring carbon particles in the crude. The doctor enlists the aid of a female Micro-biologist and together they alter the microbe and make it lighter than air so it can chase and eat the carbon polluting the air  we breathe and give the microbe a hard shell called a sheen. Read how a small group of terrorists get involved and plan to use this discovery to help them perfect a biological weapon of mass destruction.
tagline: A discovery that could heal the atmosphere—or become a weapon.

title: Operation Dragon Fire
synopsis: An Iraqi terrorist, admitted to the United States after helping American troops, recruits a group for a series of coordinated attacks. Targets in New York and Washington are intended to conceal a more dangerous objective: a nuclear strike between the White House and the Capitol. The specialized Dragon Fire troops are called upon to stop a plan built around distraction, timing, and escalating threats.
sourceSynopsis: Iraqi Terrorist invited into America because of his help to our troops in Iraq, organizes a group of young Arabs from a Masque and formulates four different terrorist attacks, First: New York Subway System with the attack against Kennedy International Airport to be carried out at the same time. Then the terrorist planned to move their operations to Washington where they intend to attack a baseball game between the Mets and the Washington Commanders. These three attacks were to cover their main intention. An attack by a dirt nuclear weapon to be blasted off between the White House and the Capital Building. Dragon Fire troops are again called upon to stop this attack at all costs.
tagline: A series of attacks conceals a far more dangerous objective.

title: Bio-Level Three
synopsis: A rebel-led Libyan military command is secretly constructing twin chemical and biological factories deep in the desert. Once American intelligence discovers the project, the President orders specialized Dragon Fire troops to destroy the facilities before they become operational. The mission must eliminate the threat before the factories can place the wider world in danger.
sourceSynopsis: After the discovery of what the rebel lead Libyan military command was secretly constructing deep in their vast desert, the President of the United States immediately orders the Units of specialized Dragon Fire troops to be dispatched in order to destroy a set of twin Chemical and Biological factories before they became operational and a serious threat to the security of the rest of the world.
tagline: Deep in the desert, a secret must be stopped before it goes live.

title: Operation Dragon Claw
synopsis: A terrorist group invades the island of La Palma with a plan to place explosives along a crack in the Cumbre Vieja volcano. In the novel’s scenario, the resulting collapse would send an enormous mass of earth into the Atlantic and unleash a devastating tsunami. The Dragon Fire troops are dispatched to the island to stop the attack before its consequences reach far beyond the immediate battlefield.
sourceSynopsis: Group of Arab terrorists invade the tiny Island of La-Palma with the intent to plant explosives along the crack in the side of the dormant Volcano Cumbra Viega with the intent of dropping over 125 millions tons of earth into the Atlantic Ocean to create a Mega-Tsunami and form a tidal wave 75 meters high. The Dragon Fire Troops were dispatched to stop this attack.
tagline: A volcanic island. A devastating plan. An ocean of consequences.

title: Beyond Yesterday
synopsis: After a nuclear exchange destroys most of the world’s population, survivors develop a way to reach into the past. Their first attempts to replenish humanity using reproductive material fail. They turn instead to taking people from earlier times, including the pilots of five aircraft that disappeared in the Bermuda Triangle. Each journey leaves consequences in the Atlantic, linking the mysteries of the past to a desperate effort to preserve the human future.
sourceSynopsis: After a nuclear exchange destroys over 85% of the population of the world, the survivors developed the means to go back in time and they start kidnapping people from the past to repopulate the earth as it cools down and becomes survivable again.  First, they took eggs from women and sperm from males but they would not survive so they took to kidnapping souls. They took the pilots of the five aircraft that went missing in the triangle and each time they came to get more souls from the past, their entry caused a Hurricane in the Atlantic, but it was the only way to keep the human alive in the future.
tagline: To save the future, they must steal lives from the past.

title: Code Cold Fire Alert
synopsis: The United States builds specialized plants to destroy its stockpiles of chemical and biological weapons. Crews are sealed inside for extended shifts, with orders to remain in place if a dangerous spill cannot be contained. When a spill occurs, doctors try to escape after disconnecting a nuclear sterilization device. A lone colonel enters the containment area to restore its power, knowing he may have to trigger the final safeguard by hand.
sourceSynopsis: The United States has a vast horde of Chemical and Biological weapons stored throughout the US and they construct two Destruction plants to erase this problem. The crews working in these plants are locked inside the building for three weeks strait and they had orders if a spill happens if they can't handle it the crew was to not try and escape the building and die in place. A spill happens and the doctors try to get out of the building after they disconnected the small nuclear sterilizing device. A lone Colonel gets into the building and he enters the containment side to place a battery backup system on the nuclear device, and if forced to set it off by hand, ten inches away from his face.
tagline: A containment failure. A lone colonel. The final safeguard.

title: Trump’s Brass Escalator
synopsis: Continuing the story of Sandstorm, this novel brings the President, Vice-President, Special Forces leader Walker, and his female sergeant to New York. They are preparing to present evidence gathered in Iran to the United Nations. Before they can do so, robbers attack Trump Tower and take the Vice-President hostage. Walker and his team must interrupt their larger mission to stop the robbery and save a life at the center of government.
sourceSynopsis: The book is the continuation of "Sandstorm." The President and Vice-President of the United States, as well as Special Force Team Leader Walker and his female Sergeant, are scheduled to address the United Nations over the evidence the Special Force team found in Iran. However, before they can address the United Nations, robbers attack Trump Tower while they are there. The would-be robbers hold the Vice-President hostage, sending Walker and his team into action to not only save the life of the Vice-President but also to stop the would-be robbery.
tagline: A hostage crisis interrupts a mission to expose the truth.

title: Sandstorm
synopsis: A rogue Russian admiral sells Iran nuclear-tipped submarine-launched missiles. American special operations soldiers are sent into Iran to destroy the missiles and the submarines that carry them. They must also recover evidence of the transfer of weapons and technology—evidence that could expose how Iran acquired the means to build and launch its own nuclear threat against the United States.
sourceSynopsis: About a Russian rebel Admiral who sold Iran a number of nuclear tipped submarine launched missiles, and our Special Operation's soldiers going into Iran to destroy the missiles along with the submarines, and retrieving evidence Russia sold the missiles and technologies to build their own nuclear weapons and how to launch them against the United States
tagline: A covert mission into Iran to stop a nuclear threat.

title: Massive Vinegar Joe Platform
synopsis: China seeks United Nations approval for an attack on North Korea, presenting the operation as an effort to eliminate nuclear weapons. Behind that promise lies a broader deception involving Hong Kong and Taiwan. With no nearby military base available in the novel’s scenario, the United States turns to a massive floating platform as it responds to a growing confrontation in the Pacific.
sourceSynopsis: China uses a ploy to attack North Korea with the blessing of the United Nations, with the promise of eliminating North Korea's nuclear weapons. China continues its deception in order to sell Hong Kong to the English with the true purpose of plundering its riches and attacking Taiwan. The United States, having no military bases in an Asian region, is forced to connect a massive floating base for the safety of the world.
tagline: Across the Pacific, deception threatens a fragile balance of power.

title: The Scorpion Sting
synopsis: The story continues after Eagle’s Talon. Saddam Hussein sends another terrorist group into the United States to kill the Iraqi operative captured by American forces, along with soldiers involved in his arrest. Walker and his Special Forces team must locate the new cell and stop its campaign of retaliation. The danger follows the soldiers home, turning the aftermath of one mission into the beginning of another.
sourceSynopsis: This novel continues where 'Eagle's Talon' ended. When another Iraqi terrorist group is sent to the United States by President Saddam Hussein to kill the Iraqi operative captured and brought to the United States to stand trail, along with killing some of the American troops who invaded Iraq to take the lead terrorist prisoner. Walker and his Special Forces troops search and find and then kill the terrorist cell working in the United States and end the threat aimed against the American soldiers.
tagline: The mission is over. The retaliation has only begun.

title: Daughter of the Scorpion
synopsis: The discovery of secret military papers exposes an Iraqi biological weapons program. American intelligence learns that the pathogen could mutate and threaten life on a global scale if it is released. Captain Robert Walker leads an elite rapid response team into the Iraqi desert to find a young woman believed to know where the weapon is hidden. Time is running out as his soldiers race to locate the agent before its creator unleashes it.
sourceSynopsis: The accidental discovery of secret military papers exposes a deadly threat. The Iraqi military has developed a designer biological weapon. American intelligence quickly learns that the pathogen will mutate and destroy all life on the planet if it is unleashed. Heading an elite rapid response team, Captain Robert Walker leads his soldiers into the heart of the Iraq desert to track down a young woman rumored to know of the weapon's location. Time is running out as Captain Walker and his squad race to find the biological agent before its madman creator can use it to destroy the world.

verifiedRetailLinks.title: Daughter Of The Scorpion: Designer Biological Weapon of Mass Destruction
Daughter Of The Scorpion: Designer Biological Weapon of Mass Destruction

tagline: One woman may know the location of a weapon that could end everything.

title: Eagle’s Talon
synopsis: Iraqi President Saddam Hussein sends a terrorist group to assassinate the American President in an effort to end the sanctions on his country. Special Forces leader Robert Walker and his troops are tasked with stopping the attack. Their mission then takes them into Iraq, where they must capture the terrorist leader and bring him to the United States to stand trial. This is the opening story of the Scorpion Trilogy.
sourceSynopsis: Iraqi President Saddam Hussein wants to end the choking sanctions on his country, so he sends a terrorist group hell bent on killing the American President. Again, Special Forces Team Leader Robert Walker and his troops are sent into motion to stop the attack, and then go to Iraq and capture the leader of the terrorist and bring him back to the United States to stand trial for his failed attempt to him the American President.
tagline: An assassination plot. An elite team. A race into hostile territory.

title: Birth of Wind
synopsis: In Japan in 1333, a female samurai fights for her place in a society dominated by men. Her discipline, determination, and skill carry her through a life of conflict. When her story reaches its end, a curse placed on her sword by the shogun binds the warrior and the blade together for eternity. Birth of Wind begins a trilogy that carries her legacy across centuries.
sourceSynopsis: A female samurai warrior in 1333 is placed in the middle of the most male-dominated era in history. Her determination, skills, and disciplined fighting succeeded to the end, and her demise along with a curse placed upon her sword by the Shogun in which she and the sword would be entwined for eternity.
tagline: In a world that denied her a place, she became a legend.

title: The Wind’s Breathe
synopsis: Centuries after the events of Birth of Wind, the warrior’s cursed sword is discovered in Japan in 1996. Its new owner uses Wind’s samurai abilities against rivals in the construction industry. The second Wind novel moves the story from the battlefields of the fourteenth century into a modern world where the sword’s power finds a very different purpose.
sourceSynopsis: Following the fantastical finale of Birth of Wind in 1333, Wind's cursed sword is discovered in 1996. The new owner (her commander) uses her samurai skills against his competition in the construction field in Japan.
tagline: Centuries later, a cursed sword awakens in modern Japan.

title: Night Wind
synopsis: Wind’s sword is discovered once again, this time by the FBI. The agent responsible for it brings the blade back to the United States and soon learns that it is far more than an ordinary weapon. Wind remains bound to protect the person who possesses it, bringing the warrior’s enduring obligation into the agent’s life. The third novel carries the Wind Trilogy across the Pacific into a new setting.
sourceSynopsis: Once again, Wind’s sword is discovered—this time by the FBI.  The FBI Agent in charge of the sword returns to the United States. He quickly learns the sword is special.  Wind always seems to be in the way as she is obligated to save his life while he is in possession of the sword.
tagline: The sword crosses an ocean. The warrior’s duty follows.
